name_story.story: Rohani can be understood through the Arabic form رُوحَانِي, whose central sense is rohani; spiritual (malay form). Rohani is the Malay form of Arabic رُوحَانِيّ (Rūḥānī), meaning 'spiritual'.

faq.a: Rohani is associated with the Arabic form رُوحَانِي, whose core sense is rohani; spiritual (malay form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Rohani?
faq.a: Rohani is associated with Arabic. Rohani is the Malay form of Arabic رُوحَانِيّ (Rūḥānī), meaning 'spiritual'.
Yes — the underlying form رُوحَانِي is Arabic.
Rohani can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Rohani should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Rūḥānī is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Rohani mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Rohani is rendered روحانی and carries the sense روحانی، روحانی.

faq.q: What does Rohani mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Rohani is rendered روحانی and carries the sense روحانی، روحانی.
A romanized syllable approximation is ro-ha-ni. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Rohani?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Rohani, rohani. Script forms are روحاني, روحانی, رُوحَانِي, रूहानी.

faq.q: Is Rohani a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
